site.name: Moreco
site.tagline: Bioavailable silicon for plants, animals and human
site.description: Moreco produces and distributes a patented, biologically active and fully absorbable form of silicon (OSA) for agriculture, livestock and human health, alongside ecological disinfection with hydrogen peroxide.

introText: For more than 23 years we have worked alongside the developers of OSA. We support the agricultural sector in Europe, Asia and the United States, and since 2012 in Morocco.
The brands we bring to market are chosen with the greatest care and rank among the absolute leaders in their field. That is how we give our customers a guarantee of constant quality and safe use.

Since our founding we have worked to offer our customers new products and innovative solutions that answer their specific problems in the field. Our proprietary technologies act on two crucial levels:

introPoints.title: Optimal nutrition
introPoints.text: We ensure the plant takes up nutrients more efficiently.

introPoints.title: Natural resilience
introPoints.text: We strengthen crops from within against disease, pests and climate change.

home.introClose: By guaranteeing a healthy harvest with higher nutritional value and a longer shelf life, we help growers position their own brand at the very top of the market. That philosophy still guides everything we do today.
home.rdiText: Trials in real conditions, control plot against treated plot, on the same farm in the same season. The campaigns documented in Morocco run from Midelt to Larache: apple, strawberry, tomato, citrus, wheat, olive.
home.quoteTitle: Something specific in mind? Ask for a quote
home.quoteText: Add the products you are interested in to your request, then send it in one go. Our team replies with dosages, pack sizes and prices.

agri.name: Agri / Horticulture
agri.blurb: A unique, fully absorbable form of orthosilicic acid: higher yield, better taste and more resilient crops. Also available for biological disease control.

humans.name: Humans
humans.blurb: To be younger, healthier and more vital through biologically active silicon. Also combined with maca, L-arginine, hyaluronic acid and collagen.

animals.name: Animals
animals.blurb: Improves animal health and quality of life through an absorbable form of biologically active silicon. Also applicable to eco-disinfection.

general.name: Disinfectant
general.blurb: Ecological disinfection with hydrogen peroxide: for people, animals, agriculture and its industries.

rdi.title: Moreco Research & Development
rdi.intro: Silicon is not a promise, it is a measurement. Since 2016 Moreco has run field trials with Moroccan growers — a control plot against a treated plot, on the same farm, the same season, the same variety.
rdi.innovationLead: Always a step ahead, thanks to Moreco’s R&D
innovationText: Standing still is not an option. That is why Moreco invests continuously in biotechnological research and advanced development. Our in-house R&D department is the engine behind our high-performance agricultural inputs, developed with the most advanced technologies in the sector.

Our team of experts is devoted to designing, testing and perfecting innovative formulations. We pursue one clear goal: to give you optimal quality, efficacy and sustainability, and with them the highest possible return for the agricultural sector.
rdi.customTitle: Need a bespoke formula or product?
customText: Does your business need a specific product developed, or a formula made to measure? Whether you are looking for a solution to apply directly to your own crops, or want to formulate an innovative product for sale and distribution, our R&D team is at your disposal. We work alongside you to push the limits of innovation and design tailored solutions that meet your agronomic objectives exactly.
We are entirely at your disposal for any question. Do get in touch to explore the opportunities for working together.
rdi.trialsIntro: From the apple orchards of Midelt to turf grass, every crop documented in field photography.
